notes: Single SQLite database file created automatically if it does not exist.
One user can have one board in the MVP, with the schema designed for future multi-user expansion.

users.purpose: Stores a user account. For the MVP, the app will autoload the default user 'user' but the schema is expandable for future users.

boards.purpose: Stores the single project board for a user in the MVP.

columns.purpose: Stores the fixed Kanban columns and their current order. Column titles are user-editable.

cards.purpose: Stores cards and their current column placement and ordering.

relationships.users_to_boards: One user may have one active board in the MVP. This is designed to scale to multiple boards later.
relationships.boards_to_columns: One board contains multiple columns in a fixed order.
relationships.boards_to_cards: One board contains many cards. Each card belongs to exactly one column at a time.
relationships.columns_to_cards: A column contains many cards ordered by position.
